date_note: The Northern Miner (23 Nov) gives the attack as Friday 20 November and the CEO's remarks as made at Monday's annual meeting; 23 November is the day the company's statement was reported.
exec: Peninsula Energy requested an ASX trading halt after a cyberattack on the operating system at its Lance uranium project in Wyoming, Cowboy State Daily reports.
geo_basis: state named in the source; map pin at the centre of Wyoming
plain: Peninsula Energy says a cyberattack hit the operating system at its Lance uranium project in Wyoming. Cowboy State Daily reports operations were taken offline and the company asked for a trading halt in Australia.
summary: The Northern Miner reports a cyberattack on Friday, 20 November hit the operating server and system at Peninsula Energy's Lance uranium project in Wyoming. Cowboy State Daily reports operations were taken offline and that the company requested a trading halt on the Australian Securities Exchange on Monday. The company said only its operating system was affected, not its administrative systems in the U.S. and Australia, and that it is investigating.
title: Peninsula Energy says cyberattack hit operating server at Lance uranium project in Wyoming

validation.note: The Northern Miner (CEO remarks at the annual meeting) and Cowboy State Daily (company statement, trading halt request) are independent publishers that both state the attack on the Lance operating system; the company's ASX announcement was not read.

review.note: title, 20 Nov attack, CEO quotes, unaffected admin systems, no production/type disclosed vs Northern Miner
